text:
Maya Patel: Final check — webinar landing page copy is locked but need a quick pass on CTAs and Zoom settings. Wed 3/28 10am PT. Can we confirm captions + cloud recording + lead routing?
Jorge Ruiz: Looks good on copy. CTA suggestion: 'Get actionable latency benchmarks' instead of 'Register' — slightly higher lift.
Sam Lin: Zoom settings: cloud recording (hosts only), auto-assign captions, record transcript. Also enable 'Optimize for shared screen' for demo.
Priya Desai: HubSpot mapping: we need to tag registrants by 'benchmark_interested' and source = 'webinar_mar28'. Who's owning the field mapping?
Alex Gomez: I can wire the HubSpot workflow. Quick mapping here:
```
email -> contact.email
firstname -> contact.firstname
utm_source -> lead.source
benchmark_interest -> contact.properties.benchmark_interest (enum: yes/no)
webinar_attended -> contact.properties.webinar_2024_03_28_attended (boolean)
```
Chloe Park: Also add property `clip_followup` for folks who opt into clips/highlights. We'll trigger a nurture seq.
Maya Patel: Perfect. Recording retention? Legal asked for 90 days on S3 then move to cold archive.
RecordingBot: Recording uploaded: zoom/Redwood_Mar28_demo/recording.mp4 (processing). Transcripts available in ~15m.
Jorge Ruiz: For post-event assets — split into: full recording, 5x 60s highlight clips, transcript, and timestamped CTAs. Assign owners?
Priya Desai: I'll own clip selection + timestamps. Chloe will own landing page CTA post-run. Alex will handle HubSpot nurture + lead scoring.
Sam Lin: Zoom checklist for host before go-live: mute on entry, spotlight presenter, enable captions, ensure waiting room off, set co-hosts, start local recording fallback. Pasteable snippet:
`/zoom settings: captions=on, cloud_recording=host_only, waiting_room=off, cohosts=@Sam,@Alex`
Maya Patel: Rehearsal tomorrow 9:15am PT. Please join 10 min early for mic checks. @RecordingBot can you capture rehearsal and label it 'rehearsal_2024_03_27'?
RecordingBot: Capturing rehearsal_2024_03_27 now (will post link when done). :white_check_mark:
ZoomBot: Closed captions configured. Auto-transcript enabled. Live transcript language set to English (US).
Alex Gomez: I'll create the HubSpot list 'mar28_registrants' and the automation to tag `benchmark_interest` from the registration form. Will share flow by EOD.
Chloe Park: Post-event deliverable schedule: 24h - transcript + full recording drop to S3 + email to registrants; 48h - highlight clips and landing page update; 72h - nurture drip starts for engaged attendees.
Maya Patel: Love that. One more ask — please make sure the registration page has a timezone selector and friendly copy for APAC. Small variant: 'Join live or get the recording' with local time conversion.
Jorge Ruiz: I'll add a localized CTA and a boolean `wants_local_time` on the form.
Priya Desai: Who's doing the follow-up copy? I can draft the 24h email (short, with 1 CTA to watch + 1 to request a hands-on benchmark).
Maya Patel: Thanks team — last call: confirmations sent on form submit, calendar invite auto-sent, reminder email at 24h and 1h before. If anything slips, ping here and tag @Maya. :rocket:
